title: personal OKR weekly check-in - Liam Carter - 2026-04-28
content:
Week: 2026-04-21 to 2026-04-27
Owner: Liam Carter (eng-serving-runtime)
Check-in date: 2026-04-28

Objective (Q2): Reduce inference tail latency and improve dev onboarding for serving runtime
Key Results (Q2) (current progress):
  - KR1: Reduce 99th percentile text-generation latency for 1k-token requests on p3 instances from 420ms -> 320ms (progress: 55%)
    - Current: 362ms p99 (measured across 4k requests, regional avg)
    - Notes: Kernel selection PR improved batching; still seeing variance on cold KV-cache misses
  - KR2: Lower cost per 1M tokens by 20% through batching + cache improvements (progress: 40%)
    - Current: -12% cost vs baseline (tracking in spreadsheet)
    - Notes: Autoscaling config WIP, need more stable burst policy to maintain latency SLOs
  - KR3: Ship "serving-runtime quickstart" onboarding flow and docs; achieve 80% success rate for new devs (progress: 70%)
    - Current: Draft doc + sample infra repo merged; internal test cohort gave 6/8 success

This week highlights (accomplished):
  - Merged GH-PR-7890: dynamic kernel fallback for attention kernels (reduced p99 on longer sequences by ~8%)
  - Finished first pass of quickstart repo; added end-to-end example using local CPU fallback + small model test harness
  - Paired with SRE to reproduce KV-cache cold miss pattern; built a small sim to test warmup sequences
  - Ran onboarding trial with 8 internal devs, gathered feedback, updated docs with common pitfalls

Open items / blockers:
  - Autoscaling burst policy: still need signoff from infra (Ticket: JIRA-RT-456). Without a safe burst config, we can't tune batching aggressively for cost savings.
  - Reproducible variance in p99 under mixed workloads — possible scheduling interference on noisy neighbors for some instance types. Need SRE deeper analysis.
  - Quickstart success measurement: need an automated script to validate end-to-end flow (currently manual)

Decisions made this week:
  - Prioritized kernel fallback path over more aggressive quantization changes this sprint (reduces regression risk for quality)
  - Quickstart will ship as "beta" in the Console docs; we'll gate in-product prompts based on internal trial feedback

Next week plan (concrete):
  - Work with infra to finalize autoscaling burst policy (target: spec and runbook by Fri 2026-05-01)
  - Add automated validation script to quickstart repo (goal: green CI for end-to-end example)
  - Instrument more detailed traces around KV-cache cold misses (add sampling + labels to trace events)
  - Run a 10k-request benchmark across p3/p4 to get region-by-region variance numbers and send a short note to SRE

Risks / ask for manager / help needed:
  - Need 4 hours of SRE time next week to help triage scheduling noise (put on my calendar, please)
  - Approval for one-week burst capacity in dedicated staging to run larger stress tests (cost ~ $1.2k)

Quick notes / scratch ideas:
  - Could try pre-warming prefix cache for onboarding quickstart; tradeoff: higher cold-start cost but smoother first-request latency
  - Consider adding a small Section in quickstart: "When to use Dedicated vs Hosted for dev testing" (help reduce confusion)
  - Add a simple checklist for common errors (GPU driver mismatch, wrong CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES) in the repo README

Metrics snapshot (from tracking sheet, 2026-04-27):
  - p99 latency (1k tokens, p3): 362ms (target 320ms)
  - cost per 1M tokens: -12% vs baseline (target -20%)
  - Quickstart internal success rate: 75% (6/8)
  - PRs merged this sprint: 4 (including kernel fallback, quickstart repo, test harness, docs updates)

To-dos (personal):
  - [ ] Finalize autoscaling spec and get infra signoff
  - [ ] Implement quickstart e2e CI validation
  - [ ] Add trace labels for KV-cache events and start sampling
  - [ ] Draft short postmortem template for observed variance if SRE finds noisy neighbor issue

Notes to self (informal):
  - Keep the rollout conservative for quantization; we've seen small quality regressions in offline evals before
  - Follow up with Avery on onboarding survey wording; also ask UX if they can help craft a one-pager for internal testers

References / links:
  - Quickstart repo: GH-PR-7890 (merged)
  - Autoscaling draft: JIRA-RT-456
  - Latency tracking sheet: CONFLUENCE-1234

End of check-in.
